title: The pond, empty
logline: The millpond in 1994 with no logs in it: black water, the boom slack, a gull on it, the mill's wall reflected. The page after the last load; the water with nothing to hold.

panels.composition: A millpond with no logs, black still water reflecting the mill's wall and stack, a slack log boom with a gull standing on it, black spotting in the reflection.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, in the Era I manner, heavy black spotting brought back on purpose, a millpond with no logs in it, black still water reflecting a mill wall and stack, a slack log boom with a gull standing on it, no words
